entities.name: Orhaft Stoneback
entities.description: A human Vedrune (rune-priest) from Kaldheim and member of the Omenseekers, wise and wary.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: Faction of Kaldheim to which Orhaft belongs.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried to stop the brawl and asked Orhaft's help to reach Starnheim.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: Told Niko the story of Orhaft's name and instigated a brawl.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: Group that brawled with the Omenseekers.

entities.name: Fynn
entities.description: Present when Niko informed Orhaft of the fight.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The World Serpent, whose invasion of Starnheim was impending.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm Niko travels to in order to warn its inhabitants.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A path through which Orhaft guided a ship carrying Niko.

events.summary: Niko tries to stop a brawl between the Omenseekers and Kannah instigated by Birgi while Orhaft stays aboard xer ship.
events.quote: While Niko was trying to stop the brawl between the Omenseekers and Kannah that was instigated by Birgi

events.summary: Orhaft and Niko discuss the captured Valkyrie Avtyr and the danger of trapping her.
events.quote: Orhaft and Niko engaged in a tense conversation about the captured Valkyrie Avtyr

events.summary: Orhaft agrees to help and guides a ship carrying Niko through an Omenpath into Starnheim.
events.quote: Orhaft guided a ship carrying Niko through an Omenpath

relations.quote: and a member of the Omenseekers

relations.note: Agreed to help Niko reach Starnheim.
relations.quote: Orhaft agreed to assist Niko in traveling to Starnheim
an invasion of Starnheim by the World Serpent, Koma
